title: Gray is not the Warmest Colour
author: Pritha Chakraborty
text:
Grey sky—
Monsoon dusk—
The dull sunlight is yet to fade.
And yet it is not luminous,
Soft beams linger on,
Like the memories of a lost lover,
Remembered and forgotten—
In the mind`s abyss.

Vestiges of people,
Silhouettes sans substance,
The passing off and a faint presence,
Warmth turning to nonchalance.
Rivers of the past—
Blurred visions—
Melt into the chiaroscuro of the horizon.
